quotes.quote: The unit of analysis in this book is not a technology by itself.
Its most faithful behavior destroys its easiest business model.
A subscription model could work for affluent users, but universal deployment would require a public or cooperative option.
The purpose of the map is to locate the decision, not to predetermine it.
The contradiction is not resolved by a better pitch deck.
